name: Attention Is All You Need
shortDescription: Introducing the Transformer architecture for neural networks
longDescription: This groundbreaking paper introduced the Transformer model architecture, which relies entirely on attention mechanisms and eliminates recurrence. It has become the foundation for modern NLP models like GPT, BERT, and many others.
summary: The Transformer model eliminates recurrent neural networks in favor of attention mechanisms, achieving state-of-the-art results in machine translation while being more parallelizable. This architecture has since become the foundation for modern language models including GPT, BERT, and T5, fundamentally reshaping natural language processing research and applications.
keyFindings: Transformer architecture achieved 28.4 BLEU score on WMT 2014 English-to-German translation, surpassing previous best results by over 2 BLEU points
Self-attention mechanism allows for significantly more parallelization than recurrent models, reducing training time from 3.5 days to 12 hours on 8 GPUs
Multi-head attention enables the model to attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions
The architecture generalizes well to other tasks beyond translation, including English constituency parsing with 92.7% F1 score
